summary: Post-fork regression verification for OkaMoney AI Tips (Vite React + FastAPI + MongoDB). Backend: 34/34 pytest tests PASSED covering Auth (register/login/me/check), Picks/Games (/games, /picks, /accumulators, /sgp, /mixed-parlay, /dc-under, /dc-over, /games/yesterday, /markets), Wallet (balance/packages/purchase/spend/check-daily-free/transactions), WhatsApp status+subscriptions+admin/all, Admin WhatsApp tickets (all/build-a-bet/mixed-parlay/big-odds/mega-odds), and Ticket Machine (options/generate). Frontend: Games page loads with fixtures, bottom nav (Tips/Build/Mixed/Machine/Settings) all navigate cleanly, Register→auto-login→/games flow works with a fresh unique user, subsequent Login with same creds works, admin pages (/admin/cards shows 'Access Denied' as designed without key, /admin/verify and /admin/whatsapp-tickets render fully). No red-screen errors; only benign React Router v7 future-flag warnings in console. Mocked API-Sports data is expected per problem statement, not a bug.
action_items: (Optional / non-blocking) Silence React Router v6 future-flag warnings by passing future={{ v7_startTransition: true, v7_relativeSplatPath: true }} to <BrowserRouter> in /app/web-frontend/src/App.jsx.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1580 lines — consider splitting auth/wallet/whatsapp/tickets into routers for maintainability (non-blocking).
Several POST endpoints (/wallet/purchase, /wallet/spend, /whatsapp/purchase, /ticket-machine/generate) use query params instead of a Pydantic body; works but not idiomatic FastAPI (non-blocking).
generate_mock_picks() uses module-level globals for caching — acceptable but not thread-safe (non-blocking).
seed_data_creation: Registered one unique test user per run (TEST_user_<uuid>@example.com / TestPass_123!) via /api/auth/register. All wallet/whatsapp state is created lazily by the service; no manual seeding needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview URL: https://soccer-picks-bot.preview.emergentagent.com. Reusable pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_okamoney_api.py — always registers a fresh unique user so it is idempotent on a clean DB. Existing test creds (test@example.com / testpassword123) may not exist in freshly forked DB; suite does not depend on them. All 34 checks pass in ~4s. Frontend was verified with Playwright at 390x844 viewport — no red screens, no console errors (only React Router v7 future-flag warnings). Vite allowedHosts:true fix from prior iteration is holding.
